thread:
Ana (docs): FYI PR #6271 — SDK v3 migration guide is ready for review. I updated examples and added a migration checklist. Need security + legal signoff before merge. Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood/docs/6271

docs-bot: Preview built for PR #6271 — http://docs-preview.internal/6271 — link checker ran (1 warning).

Mike (eng): quick note — one of the code samples still shows `PROD_API_KEY = \"sk_live_abc123\"` in a fenced block. I replaced it locally but pushed as a suggestion in the PR. Please don't merge until that's fully redacted.

Ana (docs): bleh, good catch. That was a copy/paste from an old example. I'll swap to `PROD_API_KEY = "REDACTED_EXAMPLE"` and add a footnote about never embedding real keys.

Sophia (security): @Ana @Mike thanks for flagging. I'll run a quick sweep for other secrets and check the privacy note. Can you point to which file and line?

Mike (eng): it's in `docs/guides/migration/sdk-v3.md`, code block starting at the section "Auth changes" (around line ~142).

Ana (docs): pasted snippet below with line numbers so we can be explicit:
```
140 // Auth changes
141 // Old example (remove)
142 const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: "sk_live_abc123" })
143 // ...
```
I'll push a patch tonight to replace with `apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY` and a note about env var usage.

Liam (legal): I can sign off after security confirms no customer PII in examples and the API key is removed. Also need a one-line acknowledgment in the PR description that no internal customer data was included during doc edits.

Sophia (security): I'll finish the sweep in ~30m. If nothing else pops up, I can approve for security. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: CI / docs-preview reported a broken fragment link: `/guides/migration#sdk-legacy` -> 404. Failing check: link-checker (1 error).

Jen (prod): heads up — there's a release freeze starting tomorrow 09:00 PT for the infra migration. If this needs to go out before freeze we need an emergency change request. Otherwise we'll target merge the next working window (post-freeze).

Ana (docs): Not urgent for the freeze, let's target post-freeze unless legal needs it sooner. I'll add the legal ack and update the PR description once Sophia confirms.

Mike (eng): I'll fix the fragment link and push. Once docs-bot shows green and security/legal + 1 maintainer review, feel free to merge after freeze if that timeline works.

Sophia (security): Approved (pending tiny fixes) — I left one inline suggestion about removing an IP address in the logs example.

Liam (legal): Approved (conditional) — confirm the PR description includes the no-PII statement and that code examples use placeholders/env vars.

Ana (docs): Done — added PR description line: "No customer data included; examples use placeholders or env vars; keys redacted." Pushed updated doc and fixed fragment link.

docs-bot: Rebuilt preview for PR #6271 — all checks passed ✅.

Mike (eng): Awesome. Post-freeze merge planned. Thanks everyone! :party-parrot:

Ana (docs): Thanks — I'll schedule the merge for the next post-freeze window and add a note in the release checklist.
